subject: Observability implementation cutover & cadence — SkyForge integration
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Kate Miller <kate@skyforge.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability implementation cutover & cadence — SkyForge integration

Hi Kate —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Per our discussion, I want to lock in a short cutover plan and an execution cadence so both teams know the checkpoints and owners. High level: we’ll hand over dashboard templates, tracing hooks, an error taxonomy mapping doc, and an alert-routing matrix — then run a staged cutover (staging -> canary -> prod).

Proposed cutover window: Sept 25-27 (staging prep on 25, canary on 26, prod on 27).
Proposed cadence:
- Weekly 30m sync (Wed) for 3 weeks pre-cutover
- Daily 15m check-ins during cutover window
- Post-cutover retro + SLO review 1 week after prod

Deliverables we will share ahead of staging:
1) Dashboard template (service-level and model-level charts)
2) Tracing hook checklist and naming convention
3) Error taxonomy mapped to incident severities and alert priorities
4) Alert-routing matrix (on-call -> escalation path)
5) Runbook skeletons for P1/P2/P3 incidents

I’ve attached a short cadence PDF that lays out milestones and owner suggestions (redwood-implementation-cadence.pdf). Could you confirm the window and who from SkyForge should be on the daily cutover calls? Also flag any hard blackout dates.

Thanks — I’ll loop in the infra SREs once you confirm names.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
From: Kate Miller <kate@skyforge.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@skyforge.ai>, SkyForge Implementation <impl@skyforge.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability implementation cutover & cadence — SkyForge integration

Dylan —

Thanks for the clear plan. The Sept 25-27 window works for us, but can we shift the prod cutover to the 28th? We have a release freeze on the 27th internally.

Attendees for daily cutover: myself, Markus (platform lead), and our SRE lead (Shreya Rao). I’ll have Shreya send a calendar invite to your daily call once we confirm the time.

One ask up front: can you include an example of the alert-routing matrix tied to our existing on-call tool (PagerHelp) so our SREs can map quickly? If you have a short checklist for tracing hook naming we can run a quick grep to validate instrumentation.

—Kate
Kate Miller
Director, Platform Engineering | SkyForge
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Kate Miller <kate@skyforge.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 12:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability implementation cutover & cadence — SkyForge integration

Thanks — yes, shifting prod to Sept 28 is fine. I’ll update the PDF and calendar draft. Attached: tracing-hook-checklist.xlsx (quick grep-friendly naming conventions and preferred attributes) and an updated cadence PDF with the prod cutover moved to 9/28.

Agenda for our first pre-cutover sync (Wed 9/13):
- Introductions & roles (5 min)
- Dashboard templates & required metrics list (10 min)
- Tracing hooks: key spans/attributes and grep checks (10 min)
- Alert routing mapping to PagerHelp (5 min)
- Action items & owners (5 min)

Action items for SkyForge before Wed: share on-call roster + PagerHelp integration contact.

I’ll upload the checklist and cadence PDF to the shared Drive and post links in the calendar invite.

—Dylan
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: SkyForge cutover assignments and timeline

Team — quick internal note after Kate confirmed: prod moved to 9/28. Shreya Rao (SkyForge SRE) will join daily calls. Attachments we need to finalize by EOD Tues: tracing-hook-checklist.xlsx and dashboard template w/ token-level latency & model-inference error rate panels.

Suggested owner split:
- Sean: dashboard templates + Grafana import flow (deliver by 9/18)
- Laura: runbook skeletons (P1/P2) + alert-routing matrix tied to PagerHelp (deliver by 9/20)
- Dylan: tracing naming conventions, attachment, and cadence doc (deliver by 9/15)

Critical verification steps during staging (9/25):
1) End-to-end trace from request ingress to model inference + KV cache hits verified
2) Alerts fired for injected P1 error scenarios and routed to on-call per matrix
3) Dashboard panels show expected aggregation windows (1m/5m)

Please add any constraints — we’ll surface them at the 9/13 sync. I’ll draft the calendar with the Drive links.

—Dylan
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Kate Miller <kate@skyforge.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability implementation cutover & cadence — SkyForge integration

On Wed, Sep 13, 2028 at 08:42 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — quick internal note after Kate confirmed: prod moved to 9/28. Shreya Rao (SkyForge SRE) will join daily calls. Attachments we need to finalize by EOD Tues: tracing-hook-checklist.xlsx and dashboard template w/ token-level latency & model-inference error rate panels.

All good from my side — I’ve started the runbook skeletons and will map the alert-routing matrix to PagerHelp. Two quick items:

1) For error taxonomy, I recommend we publish a CSV mapping (error_code, error_class, severity, suggested_response, runbook_link) so SkyForge can import into their incident tool. I’ll attach a sample CSV in the Drive by 9/18.

2) PagerHelp requires an explicit escalation step for on-call groups; Laura -> Ops Lead -> Platform Eng. I’ll include the exact group names for their PagerHelp instance once Shreya confirms the roster.

I’ve also created a stub Drive folder (linked in the calendar invite) with: cadence PDF, tracing checklist, dashboard JSON export, and a runbook markdown template. Expect the dashboard JSON and runbook markdown by 9/18.

See you on the sync tomorrow — I’ll bring the runbook template to review.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
